506	    def _migrate_legacy_records(self) -> None:
507	        """Startup sweep adopting raw pre-provider records into local.
508	
509	        Runs only while the built-in local provider is active. With a
510	        module:factory provider configured the sweep does nothing: it never
511	        imports that provider or rewrites a local-owned record (the record is
512	        refused 503 by the owning-provider gates instead, with no fallback).
513	        Only files that genuinely hold a raw legacy version are opened with
514	        the provider, so a data directory of modern records creates no DEK or
515	        registry and loads no provider on startup -- plain reads stay
516	        provider-free.
517	
518	        Every candidate is adopted under its per-key locks: each raw version
519	        is validated and wrapped by the local provider, then the file is
520	        rewritten once atomically so the plaintext field disappears. A
521	        validation or write failure leaves the original file byte-for-byte
522	        intact (the just-minted handles are released) and never aborts
523	        startup; the record can be retried by a later export/backup.
524	        """
525	        if not provider_mod.active_is_local():
526	            return
527	        try:
528	            names = os.listdir(self.data_dir)
529	        except OSError:
530	            return
531	        for name in names:
532	            if not (name.endswith(".json") and is_valid_key_id(name[:-5])):
533	                continue
534	            key_id = name[:-5]
535	            path = os.path.join(self.data_dir, name)
536	            # One provider-free peek: only a record that actually carries a
537	            # raw legacy version proceeds to wrapping.
538	            record = self._read_record(path)
539	            if record is None or not any(
540	                ver.provider_id == LOCAL_PROVIDER_ID and not ver.handle
541	                for ver in record.versions
542	            ):
543	                continue
544	            try:
545	                with self._key_lock(key_id), self._file_lock(key_id):
546	                    # Re-read under the locks: another process may have
547	                    # adopted the record since the unlocked directory scan.
548	                    locked = self._read_record(path)
549	                    if locked is None:
550	                        continue
551	                    self._take_over_legacy(locked)
552	            except Exception:
553	                # The original file is untouched and any minted handles were
554	                # already released inside _take_over_legacy; skip this
555	                # record rather than failing startup.
556	                continue
557	
558	    def _take_over_legacy(self, record: KeyRecord) -> None:
559	        """Adopt raw pre-provider versions into the local provider.
560	
561	        Callers hold the key's in-process and cross-process locks. Only runs
562	        while the local provider is the active provider; a legacy version
563	        touched while a module:factory provider is active is refused by
564	        :meth:`_provider_for` instead (503) and nothing is rewritten. Every
565	        version is validated and wrapped *before* the file is rewritten once,
566	        atomically: if validation or the write fails the original file stays
567	        byte-for-byte intact and the handles just minted are released.
568	        """
569	        if not provider_mod.active_is_local():
570	            return
571	        local = provider_mod.configure_local(self.data_dir)
572	        adopted = []
573	        new_versions = []
574	        changed = False
575	        try:
576	            for ver in record.versions:
577	                if (
578	                    ver.provider_id == LOCAL_PROVIDER_ID
579	                    and not ver.handle
580	                ):
581	                    triple = local.import_material(
582	                        ver.algorithm,
583	                        ver.public_key,
584	                        ver.encrypted_material,
585	                    )
586	                    adopted.append(triple.handle)
587	                    new_versions.append(
588	                        (
589	                            ver,
590	                            triple.handle,
591	                            triple.encrypted_material,
592	                            triple.public_key,
593	                        )
594	                    )
595	                    changed = True
596	            if not changed:
597	                return
598	            for ver, handle, material, public_key in new_versions:
599	                ver.handle = handle
600	                ver.encrypted_material = material
601	                if ver.public_key is None:
602	                    ver.public_key = public_key
603	            self._write_atomic(
604	                self._path_for(record.key_id), record.to_json()
605	            )
606	        except BaseException:
607	            # Validation failed or the atomic rewrite did not land: the
608	            # original file is untouched. Release the registry entries this
609	            # takeover just minted so the local backend leaks nothing.
610	            for handle in adopted:
611	                try:
612	                    local.delete(handle)
613	                except Exception:
614	                    pass
615	            raise

674	    def _recover_pending_events(self) -> None:
675	        """Commit outbox events left pending by a crashed process."""
676	        try:
677	            names = os.listdir(self.data_dir)
678	        except OSError:
679	            return
680	        for name in names:
681	            if not (name.endswith(".json") and is_valid_key_id(name[:-5])):
682	                continue
683	            path = os.path.join(self.data_dir, name)
684	            key_id = name[:-5]
685	            with self._key_lock(key_id), self._file_lock(key_id):
686	                record = self._read_record(path)
687	                if record is None or not record.pending_event:
688	                    continue
689	                # A multi-file tenant restore transaction is resolved by the
690	                # RestoreCoordinator (its manifest drives the shared event),
691	                # not by this per-key recovery.
692	                if record.pending_event.get("_restore"):
693	                    continue
694	                # append() is idempotent on event_id, so this is safe whether
695	                # the crash happened before or after the ledger write.
696	                event = AuditEvent.from_json(record.pending_event)
697	                journal_id = record.pending_event.get("journal")
698	                try:
699	                    self.audit.append(event)
700	                    record.pending_event = None
701	                    self._write_atomic(path, record.to_json())
702	                except (LedgerError, OSError):
703	                    # The ledger or directory is temporarily unwritable.
704	                    # Leave the marker in place; it is retried on the next
705	                    # open (the append is idempotent on event_id).
706	                    continue
707	                if isinstance(journal_id, str) and journal_id:
708	                    # The import committed (event is in the ledger); its
709	                    # minted handles are now owned by the key, so the
710	                    # attempt's provision journal is finished.
711	                    self.drop_provision_journal(journal_id)

713	    def _commit_mutation(
714	        self,
715	        path: str,
716	        record: KeyRecord,
717	        event: AuditEvent,
718	        previous: Optional[dict],
719	        provider=None,
720	        new_handles=(),
721	        journal_id: Optional[str] = None,
722	    ) -> None:
723	        """Commit a key-file change and its event as one logical transaction.
724	
725	        The record is first written carrying the pending event (an outbox
726	        marker), the event is then appended durably to the ledger, and the
727	        marker is cleared in a second atomic write. If the ledger append
728	        fails the key file is rolled back (deleted for a brand-new key whose
729	        ``previous`` is None, restored to its prior bytes otherwise), and any
730	        provider handles the change minted are deleted, so a failed ledger
731	        write leaves neither a single-sided file nor an orphaned HSM object.
732	        ``journal_id`` (import only) is folded into the marker so crash
733	        recovery can drop the attempt's provision journal after resolving it.
734	        A crash at any point is repaired idempotently by
735	        _recover_pending_events on the next open.
736	        """
737	        marker = event.to_json()
738	        if journal_id:
739	            marker = dict(marker)
740	            marker["journal"] = journal_id
741	        record.pending_event = marker
742	
743	        def release_handles() -> None:
744	            # Best effort; never mask the original failure.
745	            if provider is None:
746	                return
747	            for handle in new_handles:
748	                try:
749	                    provider.delete(handle)
750	                except Exception:
751	                    pass
752	
753	        try:
754	            self._write_atomic(path, record.to_json())
755	            self.audit.append(event)
756	        except BaseException:
757	            # Only roll the file back when it may have landed: a failure of
758	            # the ledger append, or of the initial write after a partial file.
759	            if os.path.exists(path):
760	                if previous is None:
761	                    try:
762	                        os.unlink(path)
763	                    except OSError:
764	                        pass
765	                else:
766	                    try:
767	                        self._write_atomic(path, previous)
768	                    except Exception:
769	                        pass
770	            release_handles()
771	            raise
772	        # The durable ledger append is the commit point: the change and its
773	        # event are now authoritative and must never be rolled back. Clearing
774	        # the marker is best-effort housekeeping; a failure here (or a crash)
775	        # is repaired on the next open and must not surface as a failed
776	        # request or trigger handle deletion.
777	        record.pending_event = None
778	        try:
779	            self._write_atomic(path, record.to_json())
780	        except OSError:
781	            pass

785	            lock = self._locks.get(key_id)
786	            if lock is None:
787	                lock = threading.Lock()

797	    @contextmanager
798	    def _timed_inproc(self, key_id: str, deadline) -> Iterator[None]:
799	        """Acquire the per-key in-process lock against a shared deadline."""
800	        inproc = self._key_lock(key_id)
801	        remaining = max(deadline - time.monotonic(), 0.0)
802	        if not inproc.acquire(timeout=remaining):
803	            raise LockTimeout(key_id)
804	        try:
805	            yield
806	        finally:
807	            inproc.release()

809	    @contextmanager
810	    def _file_lock(self, key_id: str, deadline=None) -> Iterator[None]:
811	        """Cross-process advisory lock guarding mutation of a single key.
812	
813	        The in-process lock is taken separately by callers. With ``deadline``
814	        (a monotonic deadline) the fcntl lock is acquired non-blocking with
815	        polling and :class:`LockTimeout` is raised when the deadline passes;
816	        otherwise this blocks until acquired, the historical behavior.
817	        """
818	        lock_path = self._lock_path_for(key_id)
819	        if fcntl is None:  # pragma: no cover - non-POSIX platforms
820	            yield
821	            return
822	        fd = os.open(lock_path, os.O_RDWR | os.O_CREAT, 0o600)
823	        acquired = False
824	        try:
825	            if deadline is None:
826	                fcntl.flock(fd, fcntl.LOCK_EX)
827	            else:
828	                while True:
829	                    try:
830	                        fcntl.flock(fd, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
831	                        break
832	                    except BlockingIOError:
833	                        remaining = deadline - time.monotonic()
834	                        if remaining <= 0:
835	                            raise LockTimeout(key_id)
836	                        time.sleep(min(0.02, remaining))
837	            acquired = True
838	            yield
839	        finally:
840	            if acquired:
841	                fcntl.flock(fd, fcntl.LOCK_UN)
842	            os.close(fd)

844	    def _write_atomic(self, path: str, payload: dict) -> None:
845	        """Write JSON to path atomically, with owner-only permissions.
846	
847	        The temp file is fsynced before the rename, so a crash at any point
848	        leaves either the previous file or the complete new file.
849	        """
850	        fd, tmp_path = tempfile.mkstemp(dir=self.data_dir, suffix=".tmp")
851	        try:
852	            with os.fdopen(fd, "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
853	                json.dump(payload, fh)
854	                fh.flush()
855	                os.fsync(fh.fileno())
856	            os.chmod(tmp_path, 0o600)
857	            os.replace(tmp_path, path)
858	        except BaseException:
859	            try:
860	                os.unlink(tmp_path)
861	            except OSError:
862	                pass
863	            raise

873	        except (KeyError, TypeError, ValueError):

877	    def _provider_for(provider_id: str):

880	        The built-in local provider is usable only while ``KEYMGR_PROVIDER``

902	    def create(self, tenant_id: str, algorithm: str, label: str) -> KeyRecord:

910	        separately.

921	                VersionRecord(
922	                    version=1,
923	                    created_at=created_at,
924	                    algorithm=algorithm,

926	                    provider_id=provider.provider_id,

928	                    encrypted_material=triple.encrypted_material,
929	                )
930	            ],

936	        )

957	    def rotate(
958	        self,
959	        key_id: str,
960	        tenant_id: str,
961	        algorithm: str,
962	        event_id: Optional[str] = None,
963	        lock_timeout: Optional[float] = None,
964	    ) -> Optional[KeyRecord]:
965	        """Append a new version with fresh material.
966	
967	        Returns None for an unknown or foreign key. Versions are strictly
968	        incrementing; the on-disk state is read, extended and written back
969	        atomically under per-key locks so concurrent rotations never lose a
970	        version or leave a dangling current pointer.
971	
972	        An idempotent operation supplies ``event_id`` (its operation_id, so a
973	        retried/crashed rotation dedupes on one id) and ``lock_timeout``: if
974	        the per-key lock cannot be taken within it, :class:`LockTimeout` is
975	        raised before any provider call or write.
976	        """
977	        if not _KEY_ID_RE.fullmatch(key_id):
978	            return None
979	        path = self._path_for(key_id)
980	        with self.key_locks(key_id, timeout=lock_timeout):
981	            record = self._read_record(path)
982	            if record is None or record.tenant_id != tenant_id:
983	                return None
984	            # A version is rotated on the provider that owns the record;
985	            # switching providers mid-key is refused (503), never silently
986	            # migrated.
987	            provider = self._provider_for(record.current.provider_id)
988	            previous = record.to_json()
989	            # Mint the committing event and its provision journal *before*
990	            # the provider call: a crash after the backend mints the new
991	            # version's handle but before the commit point is reaped at the
992	            # next open exactly like an import (event absent -> handle
993	            # deleted, key file left at its prior version).
994	            next_number = record.current_version + 1
995	            created_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
996	            event = self.audit.new_event(
997	                tenant_id, audit_mod.ACTION_ROTATE, key_id,
998	                audit_mod.OUTCOME_SUCCESS, timestamp=created_at,
999	                event_id=event_id,
1000	            )
1001	            journal_id, journal_path = self._new_provision_journal(
1002	                event.event_id
1003	            )
1004	            try:
1005	                triple = provider.rotate(algorithm)
1006	                self._append_provision(
1007	                    journal_path, provider.provider_id, triple.handle
1008	                )
1009	                record.append_version(
1010	                    VersionRecord(
1011	                        version=next_number,
1012	                        created_at=created_at,
1013	                        algorithm=algorithm,
1014	                        public_key=triple.public_key,
1015	                        provider_id=provider.provider_id,
1016	                        handle=triple.handle,
1017	                        encrypted_material=triple.encrypted_material,
1018	                    )
1019	                )
1020	                try:
1021	                    self._commit_mutation(
1022	                        path, record, event, previous,
1023	                        provider=provider, new_handles=(triple.handle,),
1024	                        journal_id=journal_id,
1025	                    )
1026	                except BaseException:
1027	                    # Ledger/write failure: the file was already rolled back
1028	                    # inside _commit_mutation; make sure the backend object is
1029	                    # gone as well (the journal is the crash safety net).
1030	                    try:
1031	                        provider.delete(triple.handle)
1032	                    except Exception:
1033	                        pass
1034	                    raise
1035	            except BaseException:
1036	                self.drop_provision_journal(journal_id)
1037	                raise
1038	            # Committed: the new handle is owned by the appended version and
1039	            # the durable event makes the journal obsolete.
1040	            self.drop_provision_journal(journal_id)
1041	        return record
1042	
1043	    def revoke(
1044	        self, key_id: str, tenant_id: str, reason: str, operator: str
1045	    ) -> Optional[KeyRecord]:
1046	        """Mark a key as revoked, keeping the first revocation's values.
1047	
1048	        Returns None for an unknown or foreign key. The read-modify-write
1049	        runs under the same per-key locks as rotation and is committed
1050	        atomically, so repeated or concurrent revokes are idempotent: the
1051	        first reason/operator/revoked_at win and are never overwritten.
1052	        """
1053	        if not _KEY_ID_RE.fullmatch(key_id):
1054	            return None
1055	        path = self._path_for(key_id)
1056	        with self._key_lock(key_id), self._file_lock(key_id):
1057	            record = self._read_record(path)
1058	            if record is None or record.tenant_id != tenant_id:
1059	                return None
1060	            event = self.audit.new_event(
1061	                tenant_id, audit_mod.ACTION_REVOKE, key_id,
1062	                audit_mod.OUTCOME_SUCCESS,
1063	            )
1064	            if record.status != "revoked":

1066	                record.status = "revoked"

1191	            ver["algorithm"], ver["public_key"], ver["private_material"]
1192	        )

1196	            triple.public_key
1197	            if triple.public_key is not None
1198	            else ver["public_key"]
1199	        )
1200	        record = VersionRecord(
1201	            version=ver["version"],
1202	            created_at=ver["created_at"],
1203	            algorithm=ver["algorithm"],
1204	            public_key=public_key,
1205	            provider_id=target.provider_id,
1206	            handle=triple.handle,

1238	    def import_bundle(
1239	        self,
1240	        tenant_id: str,
1241	        payload: dict,
1242	        event_id: Optional[str] = None,
1243	        lock_timeout: Optional[float] = None,
1244	    ) -> tuple:
1245	        """Persist a validated export payload under the importing tenant.
1246	
1247	        Returns (IMPORT_CREATED, record) for a brand-new key_id, or
1248	        (IMPORT_CONFLICT, existing) when the key_id already exists; the
1249	        existing record on disk is never touched, and the caller decides 409
1250	        versus 404 from its owner. Every version is adopted through the
1251	        matching provider (a mismatch raises ProviderUnavailable -> 503 and
1252	        malformed material ProviderInvalidMaterial -> 400) **before** the
1253	        conflict recheck or any file is written; handles minted by a refused
1254	        or failed attempt are all deleted and no file or audit line changes.
1255	        A successful import and its audit event commit through the same
1256	        outbox transaction as create/rotate.
1257	
1258	        For an idempotent operation the per-key lock is acquired (with
1259	        ``lock_timeout``) **before** the provision journal or any provider
1260	        handle exists, so a timed-out wait writes no key, audit event or
1261	        handle. ``event_id`` names the committing audit event after the
1262	        operation_id.
1263	        """
1264	        key_id = payload["key_id"]
1265	        # Acquire the key lock first: a lock-wait timeout must surface before
1266	        # a journal, handle or event exists.
1267	        with self.key_locks(key_id, timeout=lock_timeout):
1268	            # Mint the committing event up front so the provision journal is
1269	            # named after its event_id: a leftover journal resolves at any
1270	            # startup by asking the ledger whether the event committed.
1271	            event = self.audit.new_event(
1272	                tenant_id, audit_mod.ACTION_IMPORT, key_id,
1273	                audit_mod.OUTCOME_SUCCESS, event_id=event_id,
1274	            )
1275	            journal_id, journal_path = self._new_provision_journal(event.event_id)
1276	            try:
1277	                adopted = []  # (provider, handle)
1278	                versions = []
1279	                try:
1280	                    for ver in payload["versions"]:
1281	                        version_record, target = self._adopt_imported_version(
1282	                            ver, journal_path
1283	                        )
1284	                        versions.append(version_record)
1285	                        adopted.append((target, version_record.handle))
1286	                except BaseException:
1287	                    self._release_handles(adopted)
1288	                    raise
1289	                record = KeyRecord(
1290	                    key_id=key_id,
1291	                    tenant_id=tenant_id,
1292	                    label=payload["label"],
1293	                    versions=versions,
1294	                    current_version=payload["current_version"],
1295	                    status=payload["status"],
1296	                    reason=payload["reason"],
1297	                    operator=payload["operator"],
1298	                    revoked_at=payload["revoked_at"],
1299	                )
1300	                path = self._path_for(key_id)
1301	                # Conflict recheck only after every version validated and
1302	                # every provider call succeeded; nothing has been written.
1303	                existing = self._read_record(path)
1304	                if existing is not None:
1305	                    self._release_handles(adopted)
1306	                    return IMPORT_CONFLICT, existing
1307	                try:
1308	                    # Rollback of the just-created file plus explicit handle
1309	                    # release below; the provision journal also reaps on
1310	                    # crash.
1311	                    self._commit_mutation(
1312	                        path, record, event, None,
1313	                        journal_id=journal_id,
1314	                    )
1315	                except BaseException:
1316	                    self._release_handles(adopted)
1317	                    raise
1318	                # Committed: the handles are owned by the new record and the
1319	                # durable event makes the journal obsolete.
1320	                self.drop_provision_journal(journal_id)
1321	                journal_id = None
1322	                return IMPORT_CREATED, record
1323	            finally:
1324	                if journal_id is not None:
1325	                    # Any non-commit exit (provider failure, validation, conflict,
1326	                    # aborted transaction): every minted handle was released
1327	                    # above; the journal itself is no longer needed.
1328	                    self.drop_provision_journal(journal_id)
